buildCommand: curl -sL https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_3.47.3-stable.tar.xz -o /tmp/flutter.tar.xz && tar -xJf /tmp/flutter.tar.xz -C /opt && git config --global --add safe.directory /opt/flutter && /opt/flutter/bin/flutter --version && /opt/flutter/bin/flutter pub get && /opt/flutter/bin/flutter build web --release
